setup_env: create a MuJoCo Warp batched simulation environment from a config and reference trajectory data
step_env: step all parallel simulation worlds forward using the provided MuJoCo control inputs
get_reward: compute the non-terminal step reward for batched MJWP worlds based on position and velocity tracking
get_terminate: compute termination flags for batched worlds by comparing object or base pose error against thresholds
load_env_params: update simulation parameters like contact pair margin, object offset, and actuator gains on the MJWP environment
